description: Source code for the AudioStreamInternalPlay class, implementing audio stream playback functionalities including opening, pausing, flushing, buffer management, data processing, and callback handling within the Android AAudio framework.

classes.name: AudioStreamInternalPlay
classes.description: Implements internal audio stream playback with buffer management, control, and callback handling within the Android AAudio framework.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Initializes the audio stream with configuration parameters from the builder, configuring the flow graph and setting ramp length.

methods.name: requestPause_l
methods.description: Pauses the audio stream, stops the clock model, updates state, and interacts with the service interface.

methods.name: requestFlush_l
methods.description: Flushes the audio stream buffers via the service interface and updates the stream state.

methods.name: prepareBuffersForStart
methods.description: Prepares buffers by erasing data memory to prevent stale data playback.

methods.name: advanceClientToMatchServerPosition
methods.description: Adjusts client read/write counters to synchronize with server position, preventing retrograde motion.

methods.name: onFlushFromServer
methods.description: Handles server flush event by aligning client position.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the stream, blocking if necessary, with a specified timeout.

methods.name: processDataNow
methods.description: Processes and writes data to the buffer, manages underruns, and schedules wake-up times for buffer management.

methods.name: writeNowWithConversion
methods.description: Handles data conversion and writes data in one or two parts to the buffer.

methods.name: getFramesRead
methods.description: Returns the total number of frames read, considering hardware and service offsets.

methods.name: getFramesWritten
methods.description: Returns the total number of frames written, considering service offsets.

methods.name: callbackLoop
methods.description: Main loop for handling audio callbacks, processing data, and managing stream state.

methods.name: doSetVolume
methods.description: Sets the target volume for the stream based on stream volume and duck/mute volume.
